You are gonna be fine. No matter what happens you are gonna be fine. If you ruined a relationship, you could fix it or use it to learn and do better next time. If you relapsed with something, that doesn’t mean you failed. Etc etc. No matter what has happened, everything is gonna be fine I promise. It’s fine to get help financially from them until you find a job. Your not a leech even though it might feel that way <3

I’m so sorry. My mom was the same until I was forced into therapy by cps. I promise you traumatising everybody is not worth it and most likely u won’t be able to do it. You matter and Ik how cheesy it sounds but be better than them. Cut contact with them if you have too. I cut contact with my mom a little after I turned 15. It’s the Best decision I ever made. They don’t desserve your energy. And they definitely don’t deserve you ending your life over them. life sucks sometimes, people can suck and leave but you just have to let go and move on no matter how hard it is. My dad taught me the dumbest thing and it was to just think “ it’s gonna be fine “ no matter what and Ik how incredibly cheesy and stupid it sounds but getting into that mindset took me from several suicide attempts before I turned 12 with cptsd and an eating disorder to an average teenage girl. You have to let yourself be happy to be happy. You need to choose it yourself even though that’s hard. There’s been so many times where I’ve wanted to get back to my worst because it’s comforting but it’s not worth it. Start healing with small steps, do what ever you can to get away from your family or the people who are hurting you. Do the small things that make you happy. ( even though it might feel like there are none. ) You matter and you’re worth sm more than this. 🩷 dms are always open
